title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
summary: Keeps D1 queries off central Postgres via Workers KV routing and per-database heartbeats that repair stale state.

title: How we built saga rollbacks for Cloudflare Workflows
summary: Turns hand-written catch-block undo into per-step rollbacks unwound in reverse start order from durable history.

title: Our billing pipeline was suddenly slow. The culprit was a hidden bottleneck in ClickHouse
summary: Traces slow billing jobs to ClickHouse planners copying the parts list under an exclusive mutex, then makes it shared.

title: BGP zombies and excessive path hunting
summary: Ties stuck routes to path hunting after a more-specific withdrawal, then drains by pre-announcing a same-length prefix.

title: R2 SQL: a deep dive into our new distributed query engine
summary: Avoids full-plan delays on huge Iceberg tables by streaming pruned row groups in ORDER BY order so top-K ends early.

title: How TimescaleDB helped us scale analytics and reporting
summary: Tackles slow raw device-log queries in Postgres with TimescaleDB's columnstore, as ClickHouse needs batched inserts.

title: How Cloudflare's systems dynamically route traffic across the globe
summary: Replaces prefix withdrawals that moved too much traffic with Traffic Manager forwarding CPU-time shares via Plurimog.

title: Upgrading one of the oldest components in Cloudflare's software stack
summary: Ends FL releases stalling for memory, as NGINX upgrades ran both instances at once, by swapping workers one by one.

title: How Cloudflare runs Prometheus at scale
summary: Stops cardinality spikes from crashing Prometheus or failing scrapes by patching it to skip only new series at a cap.

title: How Rust and Wasm power Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1
summary: Replaces Knot Resolver, whose blocking Lua plugins and synced cache wipes spiked latency, with BigPineapple in Rust.

title: How we built Pingora, the proxy that connects Cloudflare to the Internet
summary: Fixes low origin connection reuse from NGINX's per-worker pools with Pingora, a Rust proxy whose threads share one pool.

title: Missing Manuals - io_uring worker pool
summary: Bounds io_uring's worker-per-request growth with IORING_REGISTER_IOWQ_MAX_WORKERS, as RLIMIT_NPROC can make it spin.

title: Lessons Learned from Scaling Up Cloudflare's Anomaly Detection Platform
summary: Removes a bot-scoring bottleneck in linear-time Redis PFMERGE by capping how often each site-visitor pair is rescored.

title: The effect of switching to TCMalloc on RocksDB memory use
summary: Traces Quicksilver's RSS far above its heap to glibc arenas that can't share freed memory, then moves to TCMalloc.

title: A Byzantine failure in the real world
summary: Traces API outages to a partial switch failure that tied etcd elections and forced a failover, overloading the auth DB.

title: Moving Quicksilver into production
summary: Retires Kyoto Tycoon without downtime via a bridge, then traces replication lag to SSDs worn by LMDB copy-on-write.

title: Getting to the Core: Benchmarking Cloudflare's Latest Server Hardware
summary: Avoids slow cross-socket memory access on dual-socket Core servers by refreshing them with single-socket CPUs.

title: Introducing Quicksilver: Configuration Distribution at Internet Scale
summary: Replaces Kyoto Tycoon, whose flush lock stalled reads and whose replication lost entries, with Quicksilver on LMDB.

title: The problem with thread^W event loops
summary: Keeps slow WAF requests from stalling every connection on an NGINX worker by moving the WAF to NGINX thread pools.

title: When Bloom filters don't bloom
summary: Traces slow dedup to cache misses from probing a Bloom filter larger than L3, then uses a linear-probing hash table.

title: io_submit: The epoll alternative you've never heard about
summary: Avoids a syscall per socket read or write by batching them in io_submit, and drops epoll_ctl churn via IOCB_CMD_POLL.

title: L4Drop: XDP DDoS Mitigations
summary: Replaces Floodgate, whose Solarflare bypass fails on new NICs, with L4Drop compiling Gatebot rules into XDP eBPF.

title: How we scaled nginx and saved the world 54 years every day
summary: Traces tail latency to SSD stalls blocking NGINX event loops, then offloads cache-file open() to the thread pool.

title: HTTP Analytics for 6M requests per second using ClickHouse
summary: Replaces Postgres and Citus rollups, each a single point of failure, with ClickHouse SummingMergeTree views.
